notes.title: Demo Update 0.0.2
notes.content:
Now it is easier to take the bag off your head

A red outline will appear so you can take the bag off your head.

Fixed a problem with vents where only one screwdriver worked for them, now any one you find on the map should work

The keypad should be easier to press.
